# PlayCDTrack <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PlayCDTrack:Int32 track:Int32, mode:Int32=1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `track` | In | Int32 | required | The track number, counted from 1. |
| `mode` | In | Int32 | `1` | 1 plays the track once (the default), 2 repeats it and 3 plays on to the end of the disc. |

**Returns:** The channel of the track in the original. Always 0 here, as nothing is played.

## Description

Plays a track of an audio CD in the original. There is no CD playback here.

## Differences

* Always returns 0 and plays nothing. Use [PlayMusic](PlayMusic) with ripped tracks instead.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Local ch = PlayCDTrack(2, 1)
If ch = 0 Then Print "No CD audio available" Else Print "Playing track 2"
WaitKey
```
